words.trans: adj. 剥落的，成片脱落的
examples: The paint on the old shed was flaking off in the damp.

words.trans: v. 嗡嗡作响，发出低沉连续的嗡鸣（hum 的过去式与过去分词为 hummed）
examples: The old fridge hummed quietly in the corner.

words.trans: v. 汩汩作响，流水发出咕噜声
examples: Water gurgled down the drain.

words.trans: adj. 低沉的，被捂住听不清的
examples: We heard a muffled shout from behind the door.

words.trans: v. 捆绑、捆扎；truss up 捆紧，专门指把人手脚紧紧捆住
examples: They trussed the prisoner's hands up behind his back.

words.trans: adj. 加重的，坠了重物的
examples: The rope had a weighted end so it would reach the ground.

words.trans: adj. 困惑的，茫然不解的
examples: He looked completely baffled by the question.

words.trans: 飞驰掠过，一闪而过
examples: The pickup truck flashed past them on the narrow lane.

words.trans: n. 皮卡、皮卡车（pickup truck 的简写）
examples: A dusty pickup was parked outside the compound.

words.trans: 领某人进入某处。重点：带路+指引，让对方跟着走进去，常是工作人员/警察/接待人员这类身份
examples: The guard showed them into a cold concrete room.

words.trans: adj. 震惊的，惊愕的
examples: She stood there, stunned, unable to move.

words.trans: n./v. 使眼色，眨一只眼（示意）
examples: He gave her a quick wink to reassure her.

words.trans: 迅速离开，疾驰而去
examples: The men speed off in the van before anyone could note the plate.

words.trans: 固定句型，不要拆成“as well=也”。含义：倒不如；简直就跟……一样（做了也没用，现实等于没发生）
examples: He might as well have never come at all.

words.trans: adj. 蜿蜒曲折的
examples: They followed a twisting track up towards the crags.

words.trans: n.（岩石、墙的）窄缝、裂隙、裂口
examples: A thin stream of water trickled from a crevice in the rock.

words.trans: n. 悬崖、峭壁（常用复数 crags）
examples: The crags rose grey and bare above the treeline.

words.trans: n. 刀片刺网、带刺铁丝网
examples: Coils of razor wire topped the high perimeter fence.

words.trans: n. 冲锋枪
examples: One of the men carried a sub-machine gun across his chest.

words.trans: n. 有围墙的大院、围场、封闭据点
examples: The walled compound looked more like a prison than a farm.

words.trans: n. 各种各样；一批不同种类的东西
examples: An assortment of old vehicles rusted in the yard.

words.trans: 各式各样的车辆。侧重：实物堆在一起、肉眼可见的一堆各色物件
examples: The barn held an assortment of vehicles — quad bikes, a dumper truck, a pickup.

words.trans: n. 四轮越野摩托车
examples: A bright red quad bike stood by the door.

words.trans: n. 自卸小货车、翻斗车
examples: The engine of the dumper truck ticked as it cooled.

words.trans: adv. 几乎、差不多、实际上
examples: The place was virtually empty, with no one in sight.

words.trans: v. 猛推、搡、塞（过去式同形）
examples: She thrust the heavy bag into the back of the truck.

words.trans: v. 轻轻抱、怀抱着
examples: She cradled the injured bird gently in her hands.

words.trans: v. 不断烦扰、萦绕心头
examples: A nagging doubt niggled at the back of his mind.

words.trans: adj. 令人恶心的，让人心里发慌难受的
examples: There was a sickening lurch as the drone dropped.

words.trans: 一点点往前挪动
examples: The convoy inched its way along the rutted track.

words.trans: 掌握时间、知晓时间
examples: Underground it was impossible to keep track of time.

words.trans: 萦绕在他脑海，不断折磨他的思绪
examples: The same question plagued his mind all through the night.

words.trans: 坐牢、身陷囹圄
examples: He had spent most of his life behind bars.

words.trans: 像鸡一样被捆得严严实实。truss up 专门指把人手脚紧紧捆住，like a chicken 比喻绑得动弹不得，是坏人的威胁用语
examples: They left him trussed up like a chicken in the corner.

words.word: turn something over in one's mind
words.trans: 习语：反复思量、仔细回想某件事（turn sth over in one’s mind 在脑子里反复琢磨）
examples: He turned the man's threat over in his mind, looking for a flaw.

words.trans: 心理年龄
examples: For all his size, his mental age was that of a child.

words.trans: （汽车）中控锁。汽车术语，全车一起锁门的装置；The click of the central locking was like a gun being cocked. 中控锁咔哒一响如同枪支上膛
examples: The click of the central locking was like a gun being cocked.

words.trans: 枪支上膛。cock 作动词指扳起击锤给枪上膛，这里是比喻，烘托紧张危险氛围
examples: The sharp click sounded like a gun being cocked.

words.trans: 开放式砖造谷仓。open-fronted 为形容词复合词，指正面没有墙、敞开式的建筑
examples: They ducked inside an open-fronted brick barn to hide.

words.trans: 那就万事大吉、皆大欢喜。口语习语，坏人 Mike 的口头话，带虚伪感——“只要你说了，那就一切好说”
examples: 'Tell us, and happy days,' the man sneered.

words.trans: get/catch a whiff of sth 猛地嗅到一阵气味，常指不好闻的味道
examples: He caught a whiff of diesel and damp earth.

words.trans: 吐露秘密、全盘招供。经典俚语=tell secrets；spilling the beans was not going to get him a ticket out：就算全盘招供也不能换得脱身
examples: Spilling the beans was not going to get him a ticket out.

words.trans: a ticket out (of somewhere) 比喻可以逃离险境的机会、出路，让他得以逃出去
examples: He talked big, as if this could get him a ticket out.

words.trans: 问题少年、有心理困境的青少年。固定搭配，小说/新闻高频，指家庭或心理遇到麻烦的青少年
examples: The old farm was meant for troubled teenagers, the man claimed.
